publisher: U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
ownership: FOIA-disclosable National Plan and Provider Enumeration System health care provider data
source_access: Public anonymous monthly V2 full-replacement archive; CMS states there is no charge to download the data.
allowed_use: public redistribution of allowed normalized active-organization fields with provenance
prohibited_use: representing NPI issuance or active enumeration as proof of licensure, credentialing, or an open business location
publishing active individual Entity Type 1 records in the combined business registry
publishing authorized-official personal fields, EIN, TIN, or unselected identifiers from the internal raw snapshot
publishing fields from deactivated records beyond NPI and deactivation date
inferring ownership solely from reported parent-organization name text
attribution: Source: CMS National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES) Data Dissemination V2.
retention: Indefinite for the internal immutable public-source snapshot and allowed normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Allowed for selected FOIA-disclosable active organization-provider fields with source release, observation time, transformation, status limitations, and policy retained. Deactivated records are limited to NPI and deactivation date.
